tools.name: memberarea_get_account
tools.description: Return the API key's context: the MemberArea it belongs to and the linked user. Good first call to confirm the connection. MemberArea API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: memberarea_list_members
tools.description: List members of the MemberArea, with optional search, tag, status and incremental-sync filters. Returns records in data and paging in meta. MemberArea API: GET /v1/members.

tools.name: memberarea_get_member
tools.description: Return one member by UUID, optionally with tags. MemberArea API: GET /v1/members/{id}.

tools.name: memberarea_find_member_by_email
tools.description: Look up one member by exact email address within the MemberArea. MemberArea API: GET /v1/members/by-email.

tools.name: memberarea_list_member_courses
tools.description: List every course a member is enrolled in, with their progress. MemberArea API: GET /v1/members/{memberUuid}/courses.

tools.name: memberarea_list_courses
tools.description: List the courses of the MemberArea. Set published=true for live courses only, or false for drafts. MemberArea API: GET /v1/courses.

tools.name: memberarea_get_course
tools.description: Return one course by UUID. MemberArea API: GET /v1/courses/{id}.

tools.name: memberarea_list_course_members
tools.description: List the members directly enrolled in a course, with their progress. The key needs both courses:read and members:read. MemberArea API: GET /v1/courses/{courseUuid}/members.

tools.name: memberarea_list_tags
tools.description: List the member tags of the MemberArea. MemberArea API: GET /v1/tags.

tools.name: memberarea_list_products
tools.description: List the products the MemberArea sells. MemberArea API: GET /v1/products.

tools.name: memberarea_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, with optional filters by status, member, email and creation date. MemberArea API: GET /v1/orders.

tools.name: memberarea_get_order
tools.description: Return one order by id. MemberArea API: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: memberarea_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions, with optional filters by status and member. MemberArea API: GET /v1/subscriptions.

tools.name: memberarea_list_events
tools.description: List events, optionally within a date range. MemberArea API: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: memberarea_create_member
tools.description: WRITE: create a new member in the MemberArea. Not safe to repeat: a second call creates a second member. Check with memberarea_find_member_by_email first. MemberArea API: POST /v1/members.

tools.name: memberarea_update_member
tools.description: WRITE: change a member's name, email or language. Send only the fields to change. MemberArea API: PATCH /v1/members/{id}.

tools.name: memberarea_attach_tag
tools.description: WRITE: attach one tag to one member. Repeating the call leaves the member with the same tag. MemberArea API: POST /v1/members/{memberId}/tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: memberarea_enroll_member
tools.description: WRITE: grant a member access to a course. This changes what the member can open. Required key scope: courses:write. MemberArea API: POST /v1/courses/{courseUuid}/enrollments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: memberarea_find_member_by_email, memberarea_list_orders, memberarea_create_member, memberarea_enroll_member · Private data: memberarea_get_account, memberarea_list_members · Public sink: memberarea_find_member_by_email, memberarea_list_orders, memberarea_create_member, memberarea_update_member, memberarea_attach_tag, memberarea_enroll_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: memberarea_find_member_by_email, memberarea_list_orders, memberarea_create_member, memberarea_enroll_member · Private data: memberarea_get_account, memberarea_list_members · Public sink: memberarea_find_member_by_email, memberarea_list_orders, memberarea_create_member, memberarea_update_member, memberarea_attach_tag, memberarea_enroll_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
